No build system in this repo, so I can't compile — but I manually verified the call chain and signatures are consistent.

Sync processor confirmed untouched, using the original 2-arg `save`. Summary of changes:

- `ApiHandler::handleRequest` / `RequestProcessor::process` / `DatabaseStore::save` now take `client_ip`, threaded through `src/api/api_handler.{h,cpp}`, `src/processor/request_processor.{h,cpp}`, `src/store/database_store.{h,cpp}` (added as an overload, so `SyncProcessor` keeps using the original 2-arg `save`).
- `DatabaseStore::save`'s 3-arg overload appends `" ip=" + client_ip` to its log line.
- `src/main.cpp` now calls `handler.handleRequest("hello", "127.0.0.1")`.
- `SyncProcessor::process` and `CronJob::runJob` left untouched, as required.
